summary: Verified Hindi→Hinglish copy migration for Dr. Aditya Soni landing site. Confirmed programmatically that ZERO Devanagari characters (U+0900–U+097F) appear anywhere in Hinglish mode across landing page (all sections after full scroll), all 6 service deep-dive pages, insights section + open modal, and admin/leads page. No 'undefined' text encountered on any of these. English regression: toggle switches back and all key English strings still present. Source-level scan of /app/frontend/src/ found 0 Devanagari characters. i18n.js 'hi' block fully in Roman Hinglish with langLabel='English' (i.e., displays 'English' when in Hinglish mode) and en.langLabel='Hinglish' — toggle label swap works both on desktop (data-testid=lang-toggle) and mobile (data-testid=mobile-menu-toggle + mobile-lang-toggle exist). Insights modal opens/closes cleanly, all 6 service pages render title/signs/approach/stories/next-link with 'Agli service' (uppercased) label in Hinglish. Admin /admin/leads gate accepts SoniClinic@2026 and loads leads.

integration_issues.issue: Playwright element_handle.click(force=True) and page.evaluate el.click() on [data-testid=answer-opt-N] did NOT advance the question step after the first render in 3 consecutive attempts. Likely caused by Framer Motion AnimatePresence remounting the option buttons during the 220ms 'locked' guard in SelfCheck.jsx line 88-107 — the resolved element handle becomes stale before the next question mounts. Not a user-facing bug (manual clicks work), but automated flow testing of the 8-question path could not be completed. Q1 rendering in Hinglish for all three tracks was verified (scale labels 'Kabhi nahi / Kabhi-kabhi / Bar-bar / Almost roz' present, dev=0, undef=false); results / WA summary / prefill / book-thanks were NOT reached via automation this iteration.

action_items: None critical. Optional: add a small 'answer-opt-N' data-attribute stability guard (e.g. keep buttons mounted while locked or add data-testid on a stable wrapper) so automated E2E can walk the 8-question flow without hitting the AnimatePresence remount. This blocks only automation, not real users.
critical_code_review_comments: SelfCheck.jsx: the 220ms setTimeout + AnimatePresence combination makes answer buttons flakey for E2E; consider using a keyed <motion.div key={current}> around question body only and keeping answer scale as a stable subtree, or expose a stable data-testid on the option row that survives the transition.

i18n.js: en.langLabel='Hinglish' and hi.langLabel='English' — semantics are inverted (label shows the OTHER language). Correct for a toggle button but worth a code comment; a future reader might misread it as a bug.
ServiceDetail.jsx line 208: 'Agli service' is uppercased via CSS `.uppercase`, so any innerText assertion should look for 'AGLI SERVICE'. Minor testing gotcha, not a code issue.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (all Devanagari-absence checks passed; full 8-question SelfCheck E2E blocked by test-harness timing)

test_credentials: Admin passcode: SoniClinic@2026 (from request; loads /admin/leads successfully)
seed_data_creation: One booking lead 'QA Prefill / 9876543210 / Anxiety Depression / English' may have been created during a prior prefill attempt — visible in admin leads list.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The Hinglish migration is clean at the source level (grep for [\u0900-\u097F] returns nothing under /app/frontend/src) AND at the rendered-page level (checked with page.evaluate(document.body.innerText) after full scroll on landing, all 6 service pages, insights modal, and admin/leads). If you need to E2E the SelfCheck 8-question walk, click the [data-testid=answer-opt-N] buttons using page.locator(...).click(force=True) with a wait_for(state='visible') BEFORE each click AND wait at least 500ms plus poll for 'result-band' between clicks — the AnimatePresence remount + 220ms locked guard is what tripped me up. i18n.js hi block contains: scaleLabels: ['Kabhi nahi','Kabhi-kabhi','Bar-bar','Almost roz'], progress:'Sawaal', of:'/'. WA summary intro line in Hinglish: 'Namaste 🙏 Maine abhi aapki website par 2-minute ka self-check poora kiya. Mera summary yeh hai:'.
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional bug found. The only friction was test-harness fragility around Framer Motion transitions in SelfCheck's question step.
